name: External Link Status Check
description: Monitors external links, fetches metadata, and alerts on broken links.
project_description: External Link Status Check detects outbound external URLs across content entities, stores them with fetched metadata in a dedicated tracking table, and verifies their HTTP status in the background so editors can find and fix broken links. Content entities are scanned on insert, update, and during cron; discovered links are checked asynchronously through Drupal's Queue API to keep page requests fast. Results (status code, response time, scraped page title/thumbnail, source entity, last-checked time) are shown on an admin dashboard at /admin/reports/external-links with status filters and a CSV export, and a manual full scan can be triggered from /admin/config/system/external-link-scan. Depends only on core's link and node modules.
